info.name: Globie Keeper
info.description:
End-to-end walkthrough of the Globie Keeper API (agreement-first group-bill reimbursement).

**Run order**: Health → Auth → Seeded demo → Agent tools → Full create flow → PayPal sandbox.

**Before running**

1. `docker compose up -d db` then `npm --prefix server run seed` (seed is explicit, never part of deploy).
2. Start the API: `npm --prefix server run dev` (defaults to `http://localhost:3001`).
3. Import `local.postman_environment.json` and select it.

**What works without any credentials**

Folders 01–03 run against the deterministic seed: group `KHAOSI`, one 1 200.00 THB bill split Ana 445.00 / Ben 400.00 / Chai 355.00, Ana already paid (10 Globie, rank 1), Ben `requested` against order `DEMO-BEN-ORDER`, Chai `confirmed`. `POST /paypal/webhook` is accepted unverified in development, so settling Ben needs no PayPal account — and that unlocks `award_points` for him.

**What needs credentials**

- Folder 04 stops being meaningful after `POST /bills/:id/parse` unless `VISION_API_KEY` is set: the extractor returns no draft, the bill falls back to `UPLOADED` and `PATCH /bills/:id/allocations` answers 409 `bill_empty`. Set `receiptPath` to a photo of a real receipt first.
- Folder 05 needs PayPal sandbox credentials (`PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID` / `PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET`) and a public `PUBLIC_ORIGIN`. Without them the API answers 409 `paypal_not_configured` and moves no money.

Every collection variable (`anaToken`, `billId`, `benShareId`, …) is filled in by earlier requests, so a full run needs no manual copying.

item.name: 00 · Health
item.description: Cheap liveness probe. The same handler is mounted at `/health` (container healthcheck) and `/api/health` (through the proxy).

item.name: 01 · Auth
item.description: Passwordless sessions. `POST /auth/session` needs both `email` and `displayName` and returns an opaque bearer token; every later request uses it.

item.name: 01b · Log in with PayPal (optional)
item.description: Identity-only sign-in (DEV_PLAN §2.17). It reuses `PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID` / `PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET` but never moves money. Both `start` and `callback` are browser-driven, so they answer with a 302 and never the JSON error contract — the collection turns redirect-following off to see that. Note `POST /auth/session` refuses an address that is already PayPal-linked with `409 use_paypal_login`.

item.name: 02 · Seeded demo (no credentials)
item.description: Reads the deterministic seed. There is no `GET /groups` list route, so the collection resolves ids by joining with the seeded invite code `KHAOSI` — the endpoint is idempotent for members who already belong.

pm.test('Ana earned 10 Globie for paying first', () => pm.expect(body.balance).to.eql(10));

item.name: 03 · Agent tools
item.description: The §2.11 contract. Four tools move money or message people, so they answer with a confirmation challenge first; replaying the identical body with the returned `confirmToken` executes. Tokens are bound to the member, the tool and a SHA-256 of the canonical args, and expire after 10 minutes.

item.name: 04 · Full create flow (needs VISION_API_KEY)
item.description:
Creates a brand new group so the seeded agreement does not collide (`409 agreement_active`). Everything up to `PATCH /bills/:id/allocations` runs without credentials; the parse step only produces line items when `VISION_API_KEY` is configured — otherwise the bill falls back to `UPLOADED` with a warning and the allocation step answers `409 bill_empty`.

Set `receiptPath` to a photo of a real receipt before running, and give the request an explicit file path in the body tab if Postman cannot resolve the variable.

exec: pm.test('everyone agreed — the agreement is accepted', () => pm.expect(body.agreement.status).to.eql('accepted'));

request.description: The file part must be named `file`; `kind` is optional and inferred from the MIME type. 25 MB limit, one file per request.
Returns before the vision call finishes. Without `VISION_API_KEY` the extractor produces no draft and the bill drops back to `UPLOADED` with a warning.
